blocks.content: MSP is announced by the Government based on recommendations of the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP). FCI operationalizes MSP by procuring crops, thereby ensuring farmers receive guaranteed prices.

items: CACP (Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices) recommends MSP; it does not announce it.
FCI is the primary agency responsible for procuring crops to implement MSP.
MSP ensures guaranteed prices to farmers to protect them against price volatility.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Minimum Support Price (MSP) is announced directly by the Government.
The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) recommends the MSP values.
The Food Corporation of India (FCI) operationalizes MSP by directly procuring crops.
MSP guarantees minimum price assurance to protect farmers' incomes.
